title: ENS Explorer
tagline: ENS Explorer: Your Decentralized ENS Lookup Tool. Access detailed ENS domain information via the resilient and user-friendly .eth domain at salmandev.eth.limo.
description:
ENS Explorer is a decentralized website that allows you to search for ENS (Ethereum Name Service) names and get detailed information about each domain. Key details include the owner, registrant, addresses, registration date, expiry date, and price.

Highlights:
Decentralized Hosting: Deployed on IPFS via Fleek for enhanced security and reliability.
Easy Access: Available through the .eth domain at salmandev.eth.limo.
how_its_made:
How It's Made:
Frontend: Built using React.js, ensuring a responsive and dynamic user interface.
Decentralized Hosting: Deployed on Fleek, which leverages IPFS for decentralized storage, providing enhanced security and reliability.
IPFS Storage: The website's content is stored on IPFS, ensuring that it is distributed and resilient.
ENS Integration: The contenthash record of the ENS domain (salmandev.eth) is set to the relevant deployed CID, making the site accessible through the human-readable .eth domain.
Easy Access: Visit the site via the eth.limo gateway at salmandev.eth.limo.
